subject: Web Development
title: Social Media Rewrites the Web
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Social Media Rewrites the Web.

hook.text: MySpace launched in 2003 and let users customize profiles with HTML and CSS.

buildup.text: Facebook followed with a cleaner design and a focus on real identity.

discovery.text: Social networks turned the web from a collection of pages into a stream of updates.

twist.text: People stopped visiting websites. The web came to them through feeds and notifications.

climax.text: By 2010, social media consumed more attention than email, search, and news combined.

punchline.text: The web shifted from pages to people.

quiz.question: What did MySpace let users do with their profiles?
